description: 🦄 Forge - a local-first, multi-agent software-engineering runtime that runs Claude Code / Codex-style agentic workflows entirely on your own machine via Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, and LM Studio (cloud models optional). Ships 18 sandboxed tools, 6 model providers, and a full REPL + UI dashboard in a single Node CLI - no telemetry, no lock-in.
